_doc: Per-character training combos, keyed by the character name from data/<character>.json. ideal = target frame offset from the FIRST input (60fps frames). window = tolerance in frames. Timings marked approximate are starting points — tune them to what works in-game.

Jin.name: Electric Wind God Fist drill
Jin.note: → N ↓ ↘+Y (f,n,d,df+2) — press Y on the SAME frame as ↘. The overlay shows your ↘→Y gap in ms.

Jin.name: 1,2 — Left Right Combo
Jin.note: Basic rhythm. 1 jails into 2 with up to 4f delay.

Jin.name: 2,1,4 string
Jin.note: Timing approximate — adjust ideal frames after labbing.

Jin.name: ws1,3,2,1,4,2 — full while-standing string
Jin.note: Crouch (hold ↓), release, then X. Timings approximate.

Jin.name: Beginner juggle: df+2 → f+4 → b+2,1 → f,F+2,3
Jin.note: APPROXIMATE juggle timings — lab it and edit data/combos.json to match what connects.

Yoshimitsu.name: Soul Stealer (Flash) — 1+4
Yoshimitsu.note: X+B together. i6 startup — the fastest move in the game — but -20 on block: punish and interrupt tool, not a poke.

Yoshimitsu.name: NSS Flash: b+1+2 → NSS.1+4
Yoshimitsu.note: Sheathe (No Sword Stance), then Flash. Timing approximate — the sheathe recovers in ~35f.

Yoshimitsu.name: db+3,3,3,3,3,4 — Manji spin lows into knockdown
Yoshimitsu.note: APPROXIMATE mash rhythm — lab it and edit data/combos.json. The 4 ender can also go to KIN (1+2) or NSS (B).
